AccountDeletion.title: AccountDeletion
AccountDeletion.description:
Confirms an account deletion: the account's email, typed by the Student. Compared
after trimming and ignoring case.

file.title: File
file.description: A PDF, DOCX or plain-text file of 5 MB or less

file.title: File
file.description: A PDF or DOCX file of 5 MB or less

ConsentGrant.title: ConsentGrant
ConsentGrant.description: The version of the text the Student was shown and agreed to.

ConsentPurpose.title: ConsentPurpose
ConsentPurpose.description:
Phase 1 purposes. Phase 2 adds ``linkedin_link``, ``outreach`` and ``llm_drafting``
(with a migration widening ``consents_purpose_check``).

ConsentStatus.title: ConsentStatus
ConsentStatus.description:
One purpose: the text to show (plain-text paragraphs) and the Student's status on it.

``status``: ``granted`` (active on the current version), ``outdated`` (active on an older
version: agree again), ``revoked`` (withdrawn) or ``none`` (never agreed).

DocumentDownload.title: DocumentDownload
DocumentDownload.description:
A signed URL that downloads the file as an attachment; it stops working at
``expires_at`` (5 minutes or less).

DocumentList.title: DocumentList
DocumentList.description: Newest first. Pass ``next_cursor`` as ``cursor`` to get the next page (null = done).

DocumentOut.title: DocumentOut
DocumentOut.description: One stored Document. ``filename`` is untrusted text: render it as plain text.

Feed.title: Feed
Feed.description:
My Listings ranked by Match Score, best first (ties: newest ``posted_at``, then newest
``first_seen_at``).

``state``:

* ``ready``: from my stored scores. Pass ``next_cursor`` as ``cursor`` for the next page
  (null = done).
* ``provisional``: no stored scores yet; my top candidates were scored just now (one page,
  ``next_cursor`` null), from the newest Listings. Stored scores are being prepared.
* ``setup_needed``: no skills and no job Preferences yet, so nothing can be ranked
  (``items`` is empty).

``threshold``: my Preferences threshold (60 by default). Listings below it are left out
unless ``show_below_threshold``. ``hidden_below_threshold``: the toggle is off and at
least one Listing I could see here scores below the threshold.

FeedItem.title: FeedItem
FeedItem.description:
One Listing of the ranked feed with its Match Score (0-100). ``below_threshold``: the
score is under the Student's threshold (only shown with ``show_below_threshold``). Every
text field is scraped, untrusted text: render it as plain text.

ListingList.title: ListingList
ListingList.description: Newest first. Pass ``next_cursor`` as ``cursor`` to get the next page (null = done).

ListingMatch.title: ListingMatch
ListingMatch.description: The Match Score (0-100) of one Listing for the signed-in Student, computed on request.

ListingOut.title: ListingOut
ListingOut.description:
One Listing. Every text field is scraped, untrusted text: render it as plain text.
``url`` is the source page ("Apply"); show ``source_label`` ("via LinkedIn") and the
not-affiliated notice with it.

ListingSearchResults.title: ListingSearchResults
ListingSearchResults.description:
Best match first. Pass ``next_offset`` as ``offset`` to get the next page (null = no
more; search shows the best matches, so offsets stop at 200).

ListingSkill.title: ListingSkill
ListingSkill.description: A canonical skill extracted from the Listing.

MatchSkill.title: MatchSkill
MatchSkill.description: A canonical skill in a breakdown.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: The calling account. ``role`` comes from the database, never from the token.

PreferencesIn.title: PreferencesIn
PreferencesIn.description:
The whole Preferences object (a full replace; every field is required, nullable ones
may be null). Role titles and locations are trimmed, blanks dropped and duplicates
(ignoring case) dropped; at most 10 of 80 characters each.

PreferencesOut.title: PreferencesOut
PreferencesOut.description:
The stored Preferences, or the defaults with ``saved: false`` before the first save.
``role_titles``, ``locations`` and ``degree_other`` are untrusted text: render them as
plain text.

ProfileSkill.title: ProfileSkill
ProfileSkill.description:
An effective skill. ``source`` is ``extracted`` when the active Resume mentions it,
else ``added`` (the Student added it).

ProviderKeyInput.title: ProviderKeyInput
ProviderKeyInput.description:
A Provider Key to validate and store. Trimmed, then 8 to 200 printable ASCII
characters with no whitespace. Write-only: it is never returned, logged or echoed in a
validation error.

ProviderKeyMeta.title: ProviderKeyMeta
ProviderKeyMeta.description:
What the Student sees about their Provider Key: whether one is stored, its last four
characters and when it was last validated. Never the token.

ProviderUsage.title: ProviderUsage
ProviderUsage.description: My collection status, caps, this month's spend and my latest 30 runs, newest first.

ProviderUsageMonth.title: ProviderUsageMonth
ProviderUsageMonth.description:
This UTC calendar month: ``spent_usd`` recorded so far; ``committed_usd`` adds what
runs in progress may still charge (counted against ``monthly_cap_usd``).

ProviderUsageRun.title: ProviderUsageRun
ProviderUsageRun.description:
One collection run. ``status``: ``starting``, ``running``, ``succeeded``, ``failed``
or ``refused``; ``error_kind`` says why it failed or was refused.

ProviderUsageStatus.title: ProviderUsageStatus

ResumeDownload.title: ResumeDownload
ResumeDownload.description:
A signed URL that downloads the file as an attachment; it stops working at
``expires_at`` (5 minutes or less).

ResumeList.title: ResumeList
ResumeList.description: Newest first. Pass ``next_cursor`` as ``cursor`` to get the next page (null = done).

ResumeVersion.title: ResumeVersion
ResumeVersion.description: One uploaded Resume version. ``filename`` is untrusted text: render it as plain text.

RightsNotice.title: RightsNotice
RightsNotice.description: The India DPDP Act rights notice, shown with the consent texts (plain text).

ScoreBreakdown.title: ScoreBreakdown
ScoreBreakdown.description:
Why a Listing scored what it did. The components' ``points`` sum to the score. Skills
are sorted by label: ``matched_skills`` are the Listing's skills the Student has,
``missing_skills`` the ones they do not.

ScoreComponent.title: ScoreComponent
ScoreComponent.description:
One part of the score: ``points`` out of ``max_points``. ``skills`` is the canonical
skill overlap; ``text`` is the similarity of the Student's target roles and skills to the
Listing's title and text. A Listing without skills gives ``skills`` a ``max_points`` of 0.

SkillProfileEdit.title: SkillProfileEdit
SkillProfileEdit.description:
``add``: terms (a vocabulary match becomes a skill, anything else a custom skill);
``remove``: skill ids; ``remove_custom``: custom terms.

SkillProfileOut.title: SkillProfileOut
SkillProfileOut.description:
The Student's Skill Profile. ``status`` is ``none`` before any Resume was extracted.
``message`` is set when the Resume could not be read. ``custom``, ``education`` and
``experience`` are untrusted text: render them as plain text. ``resume_id`` is null when
the source Resume was deleted (the profile is kept).

SpendCapsInput.title: SpendCapsInput
SpendCapsInput.description:
New caps in USD: per-run 0.05 to 2.00, monthly 0.25 to 100, and monthly at least the
per-run cap.

SpendCapsOut.title: SpendCapsOut
SpendCapsOut.description:
The Student's spend caps in USD. ``is_default``: never set, so the platform defaults
apply. Every run is refused before it starts when its estimate is above ``per_run_usd``
or when it could take this month's committed spend above ``monthly_usd``.
